title: Navigate Hospital HMI Main Menu to Operator, Maintenance, Setup, and Alarms
summary: On the Hospital HMI Main Menu screen, use the right-hand function buttons (F1/F2/F3/F4/F5/F6) to navigate to the Operator Menu, Maintenance Menu, Setup menu, and Alarms for totes directed to the Hospital Station. Use F3 (Previous screen) to return one screen.
when_to_use: Use when you are on the Hospital Station Hospital HMI Main Menu screen and need to reach the Operator Menu, Maintenance Menu, Setup menu, or Alarms using the Hospital HMI function keys.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Navigate the Hospital HMI Main Menu using the function keys (F1/F2/F3/F4/F5/F6) to reach the desired menu screens.
safety_notes: Do not attempt configuration changes from the Setup menu unless instructed by FORTNA support.
access_or_tools_needed: Hospital HMI / lane UI (Hospital Station screen)

system_preconditions: Hospital Station Hospital HMI is available and the Hospital HMI Main Menu screen is displayed.

visual_references.description: Hospital HMI Main Menu screen showing right-hand function buttons (F1/F2/F3/F4/F5/F6).
Hospital HMI Maintenance Menu screen with navigation buttons (2.1 Manual Control, 2.2 IO Diagnostics, 2.3 Persistent Variables, 2.4 Default).

steps.title: Open Hospital HMI Main Menu for the Hospital Station
steps.purpose: Get to the correct starting screen so the function keys route to the intended menus.
steps.instruction: Open the Hospital HMI / lane UI for the Hospital Station and display the Hospital HMI Main Menu screen.
steps.expected_result: The Hospital HMI Main Menu screen is displayed with the right-hand function buttons available.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the Hospital HMI Main Menu with the function buttons labeled for navigation (F1/F2/F3/F4/F5/F6).
steps.failure_condition: The Hospital HMI Main Menu screen is not displayed (function buttons are not present or you are on a different screen).

actions.label: Display Hospital HMI Main Menu
actions.exact_action: Open the Hospital HMI / lane UI for the Hospital Station and display the Hospital HMI Main Menu screen.

steps.title: Confirm you are on the Main menu using F5
steps.purpose: Verify the current screen is the Hospital HMI Main Menu before navigating to other menus.
steps.instruction: On the right-hand side of the Main Menu screen, press F5.
steps.expected_result: The screen confirms you are on the Main menu (F5 routes to the Main menu).
steps.healthy_condition: Pressing F5 keeps/returns you to the Main menu screen.
steps.failure_condition: Pressing F5 does not route you to the Main menu screen.

actions.label: Press F5 (Main menu)
actions.exact_action: press F5 to confirm you are on the Main menu.

stop_or_escalate_if: If pressing a function key does not change screens to the expected menu, stop and escalate to FORTNA support for assistance.

success_criteria: From the Hospital HMI Main Menu screen, F1 routes to the Operator menu.
From the Hospital HMI Main Menu screen, F2 routes to the Maintenance menu.
From the Hospital HMI Main Menu screen, F4 routes to the Setup menu.
From the Hospital HMI Main Menu screen, F6 routes to the Alarms screen.
From any menu screen, F3 returns to the previous screen.
F5 routes to/keeps the Main menu screen.
healthy_conditions: Function key presses (F1/F2/F4/F6) change screens to the expected menus.
F3 returns to the previous screen.
F5 confirms you are on the Main menu.
failure_conditions: Pressing F1/F2/F4/F6 does not navigate to the expected menu screen.
Pressing F3 does not return to the previous screen.
Pressing F5 does not route to/confirm the Main menu.
escalation_guidance: If pressing a function key does not change screens to the expected menu, stop and escalate to FORTNA support for assistance.
